$comment: Single source of truth for brand and navigation. The builder reads only this file - no page copy hard-codes the name, the tagline, or the base URL.
brand_origin: derived from the supplied tracking ID 'shopnow047c-20' because the repository contained no brand asset. See SG-25 / Q-16 - change one string and rebuild.
promise: We do not pretend to have tested these. We tell you exactly what to look for at the listing, in about ninety seconds.
base_url_note: Preview host. Swap to the production domain and rebuild (SG-17); every canonical, sitemap URL, feed URL and OG tag follows automatically.
tracking_id_status: format accepted; existence on the account unverified - see S09 / Q-06

disclosure.required_text: As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.
placement: masthead strip on every page, above the fold
inline line adjacent to every sponsored link
disclosure.link_level_text: Sponsored - we may earn a commission if you buy after clicking.
disclosure.rule: Amazon requires the sentence above, clear and prominent (Operating Agreement s.5). The FTC adds that a material connection must be clear and conspicuous and cannot be hidden behind a 'DISCLOSURE' button (S03, S04). So the sentence is rendered inline on every page, not linked to.
